section_header: AIR CONDITIONING SYSTEM — Functional Test and Adjustment
title: AIR CONDITIONING SYSTEM — Functional Test and Adjustment

content.description: Solar sensor component diagram showing a top view of the sensor assembly with internal structure visible
Photograph of the Double Vacuum Valve (DVV) mounted on the heater unit showing three connection terminals labeled A, B, and C

content.text: CHECK VACUUM CIRCUIT CONTINUITY BY BLOWING AIR

items.label: (a)
items.text:
OFF state
All circuit should be closed.

items.label: (b)
items.text:
Apply 12 volts to the positive (+) terminal and ground terminal T₁.
There should be continuity between B and C at this time.

items.label: (c)
items.text: Apply 12 volts to the positive (+) terminal and ground terminal T₁. There should be continuity between A and B at this time.

content.text: If a problem is found, replace the DVV.

content.description: Photograph of the water temperature switch assembly showing two connectors labeled 'WATER TEMP. SWITCH A' at (30°C) and 'SWITCH B' at (60°C)

items.label: (a)
items.text: Disconnect the 1-pole connector from the water temp. switch.

items.label: (b)
items.text: Check continuity between the water temp. switch and ground as follows.

content.text: If a problem is found, replace water valve.
